articles.summary: The FDA raised no objections to Lantern's key proposed protocol amendments to the HARMONIC™ clinical trial. Amendments include: (1) enriching enrollment for patients with EGFR exon 21 L858R mutations; (2) extending LP-300 dosing to a maximum of eight cycles; and (3) transitioning to a single-arm study design — changes that align with emerging data and support a clearer regulatory and partnering path. EGFR exon 21 L858R mutations account for approximately 40% of all EGFR-mutant NSCLC globally and up to 50% in Asian populations — a molecularly defined subset that consistently experiences inferior outcomes when treated with current EGFR-targeted therapies relative to patients with exon 19 deletions.
